summary: Invalidate FlashInfer tuning decisions and startup memory plans with revision 22
compatibility: The first startup retunes FlashInfer operations and reprofiles startup memory plans. Existing cache files and configured cache directories are preserved.
details: Include tuning revision 22 in the shared FlashInfer cache key, covering single-rank, rank-union, sparse-MLA, and PCIe all-reduce caches.
Require rank-union marker revision 22 before loading cached decisions on distributed ranks.
Store startup memory plans with schema revision 22 and reject earlier plan schemas.
